name: Watershed Assistance Grant Program
summary: Grants for the design and permitting of watershed restoration projects (stream, wetland and shoreline restoration, stormwater practices) and for watershed planning in Maryland, the West Virginia Chesapeake watershed and parts of Pennsylvania. Funds early project phases, not construction.

geography.label: Maryland, West Virginia Chesapeake watershed, parts of Pennsylvania

amount.note: Design up to $100,000 for stormwater and similar practices, up to $150,000 for stream, wetland and living shoreline design; planning up to $75,000

status.quote: Program Status: OPEN Deadline: Wednesday, December 9th, 2026, at 4:00 PM EST

deadline.quote: Program Status: OPEN Deadline: Wednesday, December 9th, 2026, at 4:00 PM EST

applicant_types.quote: Municipal, County, and Regional Agencies Nonprofit Organizations Faith-based Organizations Community and Homeowners Associations (HOAs) Soil/Water Conservation Districts & Resource Conservation and Development Councils Forestry Boards Public and Independent Higher Educational Institutions

geography.quote: All communities in Maryland, throughout the Chesapeake Bay watershed in West Virginia, and the Pennsylvania portions of the Octoraro and Conowingo Creek Watersheds are eligible.

access.quote: Program Status: OPEN Deadline: Wednesday, December 9th, 2026, at 4:00 PM EST

amount.quote: Generally, requests are up to $150,000 for design of Stream restoration practices, Wetland and marsh creation/restoration projects, and Living shorelines.

co_finance_required.quote: Match is encouraged but not required.

window.quote: Program Status: OPEN Deadline: Wednesday, December 9th, 2026, at 4:00 PM EST
